en: This image is a vintage black-and-white postcard featuring a hillside with several villas and houses. The buildings are labeled with names in German, such as 'Villa Buschick', 'Sonnenblick', 'Oberlausitzerhaus', and 'Hans Barthel.' Trees, pathways, and some fencing are visible in the foreground, and a densely forested mountain is in the background. The overall scene exudes an early 20th-century European spa-town or residential feel. Printed and publisher credits appear at the bottom, and the predominant caption reads, 'Gruss aus Kipsdorf.'
